services.name: Dolphin Watch Eco-Tour
services.desc: A must do trip on South Padre Island!! Duration 1.5 Hours About The Dolphin Watch and Ecology Tour combination begins with the crew of the Double Sunshine dragging a net along the floor of the Laguna Madre and bringing up live specimens of marine life. The sea life is then put into our living salt water laboratory where a Crew Member gives a presentation on what has been brought up in the net before the specimens are returned to the water. After the Eco Tour presentation the Double Sunshine continues the excursion following the dolphin pods around the Laguna Madre. BYOB! No Glass

services.name: Dolphin Watch Sunset Tour
services.desc: A must do trip on South Padre Island!! Duration 1 Hour & 30 minutes About Join us for a relaxing cruise aboard the Double Sunshine and take in one of South Padre Island’s most treasured assets, our beautiful sunsets. This cruise departs two hours before sundown and we cruise the Laguna Madre for dolphins before ending with breathtaking vistas of the setting sun. BYOB! No Glass
